shell.tagline: A private space for the person you are becoming.
shell.phaseNote: The board editor arrives in the next phase.
shell.updateAvailable: A new version is ready. Reload to update.

setup.welcomeBody: This is a private board you will read every morning and every night. Everything you put here stays on this device.
setup.startLabel: How would you like to begin
setup.startTemplateHint: Every page type, with prompts to guide you. Remove what you do not need.
setup.startEmptyHint: A blank board. Add pages as you go.

editor.relockWarning: Returning to the template re-snaps every block to its slot. Continue?
editor.emptyBoardBody: Add your first page to begin.
editor.focalHint: Drag inside the frame to set the focal point.
editor.mirrorToLegacy: Add this chapter to your Legacy page?
editor.expandCellsHint: In playback, each picture in this mosaic gets its own full screen.
editor.dragToReposition: Drag the picture to position it in its frame.
editor.affirmationBatchHint: One affirmation per line. Empty lines are ignored.
editor.affirmationRollHint: In playback the affirmations scroll continuously on one screen instead of one per screen.

import.urlPrompt: Paste an image or video address
import.pasteHint: You can also paste an image from the clipboard.
import.largeFileWarning: This file is very large. Large videos slow the morning ritual and use device storage quickly.
import.unsupportedType: That file type is not supported here.
import.urlFailed: That address could not be loaded.
import.urlIsPage: That link is a web page, not a media file. For sites like YouTube, download the video first, then import the file here.

order.title: Output order
order.empty: No pages on this board yet.

cover.name: Cover
cover.description: Your name, the workbook title, and one full-bleed image or video.

instructions.name: Instructions
instructions.description: How to use this board, in your own words.

slots.title: Instructions
slots.body: Describe how you will use this board, morning and night.

principles.name: Principles
principles.description: Your numbered principles as one pasted text that fills the page.

slots.title: Principles
slots.body: Type or paste your principles here. Numbered lines and bullet lines format automatically.

daily-ritual.name: Daily Ritual
daily-ritual.description: The steps of your daily practice as one pasted text.

slots.title: Daily Ritual
slots.body: Type or paste your ritual steps here.

vision-board.name: Vision Board
vision-board.description: A headline, keywords, and a mosaic of images or video.

legacy.name: Legacy
legacy.description: A My Story grid in the past tense. Achieved chapters gather here.

chapters.name: My Story
chapters.description: A grid of life chapters, past or future. Each tile is an image, a video, or plain text, with a caption and a status.

manifesto.name: Manifesto
manifesto.description: Long-form prose about the person you are becoming, written in the third person.

slots.title: Manifesto
slots.body: Write about this person in the third person, present tense, as if it is already true.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Character traits, style, routine, and mentors.

slots.title: Profile
slots.traitsBody: The traits of the person you are becoming.
slots.styleBody: How this person dresses and carries themselves.
slots.routineBody: The shape of this person’s day.

goals.name: Goals
goals.description: Category headings and numbered goals as one pasted text.

slots.title: Goals
slots.body: Type or paste your goals here, with a heading line above each category.

affirmations-intro.name: Affirmations Intro
affirmations-intro.description: The framing page with its own background, which also backs each affirmation screen in playback.

slots.title: Affirmations
slots.body: Each affirmation pairs a thought with an image and an emotion. Read each one aloud, look at its image, and let the feeling arrive before moving on.

affirmations.name: Affirmations
affirmations.description: Your affirmation list. In playback, each one gets its own screen.

asp-process.name: Meditation
asp-process.description: An audio meditation with optional guiding text.

slots.title: Meditation
slots.body: Optional guiding text. Insert [pause] wherever a silence belongs.

free-canvas.name: Free Canvas
free-canvas.description: An empty page. Place anything anywhere.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autosaveNote: Every change saves to this device instantly. There is no save button.
settings.archiveOriginals: Keep full resolution originals when photos are downscaled
settings.startOverWarning: Deletes the board and media from this device and returns to the welcome screen. Cannot be undone.
settings.backupBody: One file holds the whole board, media included. Open it on another device to move the board there.
settings.importConfirmReplace: Loading this backup replaces the board on this device. Continue?
settings.importInvalid: That file is not a readable backup.
settings.importNewer: This backup was made by a newer version of the app. Update the app first, then load it again.
settings.importSummary: Backup loaded: {pages} pages, {affirmations} affirmations, {assets} media files.
settings.exportHtmlSingleTooBig: Single file needs media under 25 MB. This board has {size}.
settings.ttsDeviceNote: Voices come from this device. Some Android voices need a one-time download to work offline.
settings.autoAdvanceHint: Off waits for your swipe. On holds each page for its audio, then runs the timer.
settings.fromImageHint: Pick a logo or brand image; the main colors become your palette.

playback.empty: Nothing to play yet. Add pages and include them in this playlist.

sync.title: Google Drive sync
sync.body: Off by default. The board syncs to a private folder in your own Google Drive.
sync.notConfigured: Sync is not configured for this copy of the app.
sync.statusError: Sync did not finish. It will try again.
sync.conflictBody: This device and Drive both changed since the last sync. Local edit {local}. Drive edit {remote}. Choose which to keep.
sync.reconnectHint: Session paused. Tap Sync now to reconnect.
sync.journalFailed: Journal sheet failed ({code}). Tap Sync now to retry.
sync.historyConfirm: Replace the board on this device with the Drive version from {time}? It then syncs up as your current board. You can pick another version afterwards if this is not the one.
sync.historyRestored: Restored on this device. Check the page, then tap Sync now (or wait a moment) and it becomes the version on Drive.

meditation.libraryBody: Recordings available to the meditation player. Name each one so the player menus read well.
meditation.noLibrary: Add recordings to the meditation library in the editor first.
meditation.descriptionPlaceholder: Short description, e.g. 10 min breath focus
meditation.audioMissing: Audio not on this device yet. Sync now fetches it.

tracker.postShiftItem: How do I feel right now
tracker.anchorsTitle: What does a 10 mean to you
tracker.anchorsBody: One line per item, in your own words. These keep the scale honest over time. You can edit them in settings.
tracker.postShiftSetting: Ask how you feel after each session
tracker.headlineTitle: Practice and morning baseline, 28 day averages
tracker.correlationsLocked: {n} of 60 rated sessions. Patterns unlock at 60, because early numbers mislead.
tracker.notEnoughData: Not enough rated sessions yet. This view fills in as you rate.
